name: Park National Corporation
summary: Park National Corporation operates as the bank holding company for Park National Bank that provides commercial banking and trust services in the United States. The company offers deposits, such as demand, savings, and time accounts; trust and wealth management services; cash management services; safe deposit operations; electronic funds transfers; Internet and mobile banking solutions with bill pay service; credit cards; and various additional banking-related services.
